spans.s:
O, OH:
I In addressing:
(1) हे;
(2) भो भोः,
or
भो भो (gen. to men),
o, courtiers:
भो भो
 कुलचारिणः, Vi.;
(3) अयि
or
अये (expr. of
tenderness),
o, you unbearing:
अयि असहने, Ra.;
(4) रे
or
अरे (to inferiors or in contempt),
o,
you fool:
अरे मूर्ख, Mr.;
(5) हा (in sorrow),
o, my father, o, my mothers, o, my dear friend
Sugriva:
हा तात, हा मातरः, हा प्रियसख सुग्रीव, U;
(6) by voc.
II Of joy and surprise:
(1)
अहो,
oh, how grand and beautiful is earth:
अहो
 उदाररमणीया पृथिवी, Sa.;
(2) अयि
or
अये,
oh, you
also don't know:
अयि त्वमपि न वेत्सि, Mah.
III Of surprise, anger, contempt: आः,
oh, I understand, very well:
आः ज्ञातं, तिष्ठ, Mu.
IV Of grief: हा: v. Alas.
